name: Recipe Manager
description:
The Recipe Manager plugin lets you manage a personal cookbook entirely through Claude Code or Cowork. It has four main capabilities:

1. Recipe CRUD — Create, view, edit, and delete recipes. You describe a dish in natural language and it generates a structured markdown file with YAML frontmatter
(ingredients, cook times, tags, dietary info, etc.)
2. Recipe Search — Find recipes by ingredient, cuisine, dietary restriction, difficulty, or any combination. Supports "what can I make with..." queries that rank
matches against what you have on hand.
3. Meal Planning — Generate weekly meal plans from your saved recipes, balancing variety and difficulty across the week. Also produces nutritional summaries.
4. Grocery Lists — Consolidate ingredients from recipes or meal plans into a shopping list, grouped by store section with duplicates combined.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills** and **1 agent**.

- **Skills** (5): `dashboard` (Display a dashboard overview of the recipe collection with stats, breakdowns by cuisine/difficulty/dietary, tag summary, meal plan status,…), `meal-planning` (Generate weekly meal plans, shopping lists, and nutritional summaries from the recipe collection), `recipe-crud` (Create, read, update, and delete food recipes stored as markdown files), `recipe-import` (Parse and import recipes from unstructured text, copied content, or informal descriptions into the standard markdown format), `recipe-search` (Search, filter, and find recipes by ingredients, cuisine, tags, dietary restrictions, difficulty, or any combination)
- **Agents** (1): `recipe-parser` (Use this agent when the user provides a large batch of recipes to import, complex multi-recipe text, or…)

Installs with `claude plugin install recipe-manager@claude-community` from `infosecB/personal-claude-plugins` (`recipe_manager`).
